messages:
Taylor (support): :rotating_light: Customer acme-corp reporting 5xxs and long tail latency hitting their Dedicated cluster in us-west-2. They're seeing `503` and `placement_failed` in the API response. Escalating.
Eva (ops): on it. can you paste the customer id, sample request, and a brief repro? also pinging @Jamie. :wave:
Taylor (support): customer_id=acct_84XX. repro: run this curl at ~120 rps for ~3 minutes against our dedicated endpoint `https://dedicated.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Taylor (support): ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-13b","prompt":"summarize ...","max_tokens":256}' \
  https://dedicated.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Taylor (support): response snippet: `\{"error":"placement_failed","code":503,"message":"no available GPUs to place request"\}` and later `throttled: capacity_exceeded`. Also customer sees billing alerts about rate-limits being applied mid-rollout.
Jamie (SRE): I can see the dedicated pool `dedicated-west-2-pool-3` spiking and the autoscaler went into backoff. API gateway is queueing requests; our queue length spiked to ~720. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/cluster/dedicated-west-2 (internal).
infra-bot: ALERT: dedicated-west-2-pool-3 GPU allocation at 100% (8/8 nodes active), pending scale events: 3, queued_requests: 720, failed_placements: 186 in last 10m.
Maya (ML): noting many requests forced fallback to the larger variant `gptx-13b-fp16` because `gptx-13b-q4` machine wasn't available; that increases GPU mem usage and per-request time ~2.6x which worsens queueing.
Chris (eng): immediate mitigations: 1) enable regional failover for acme-corp to `dedicated.us-east-1` (manual route) 2) temporarily allow burst capacity on pool-2 (increase `burst_concurrency` to 250) 3) apply short-term request-rate cap for the customer to 80rps while we drain. Commands:
Chris (eng): ```yaml
# rollout snippet
policies:
  - name: acme-fallback
    match: account:acct_84XX
    route: [dedicated.us-east-1, dedicated.us-west-2]
    fallback: true
    burst_concurrency: 250
```
Eva (ops): Jamie, can we scale pool-3 faster? autoscaler logs show retries failing due to pending host provisioning in the region (quota). If quota is the blocker we need cloud quota request or failover plan.
Jamie (SRE): confirmed: region GPU quota exhausted; provisioning requests are pending approval from cloud. I've opened URGENT quota case (case #CLOUD-99401). In the meantime let's shift critical customers to eu-west-1 or us-east-1.
Robin (sales): acme-corp is on a committed Dedicated contract; they're on a hard SLA — they're on my line. They've started calling and flagged billing interruptions when we applied rate-limits. Need comms template ASAP.
Taylor (support): drafting comms: "We're investigating elevated latency and placement failures in us-west-2 Dedicated. We've put temporary reroutes in place and limited burst rates to stabilize. Next update in 30m"
Maya (ML): action: prepare a lower-memory model variant (q4_0) for acme's workload as a mid-term mitigation, plus an eval to ensure quality parity. I'll start the quantization job and a small rollout.
Chris (eng): postmortem triggers: >10% customer requests 5xx for >10m, any quota-blocked scale event. flagging this one. I'll prepare a rollback/route plan doc and a one-click reroute script.
Eva (ops): action items: 1) apply manual route for acct_84XX to us-east-1 (Chris/Taylor) 2) request cloud quota expedite (Jamie) 3) limit acme to 80rps (Taylor) 4) prepare comms (Robin/Taylor) 5) follow-up postmortem (Chris/Maya). I'll update the incident board.
Taylor (support): done: applied rate cap and opened the manual route to us-east-1, customer traffic now showing in us-east-1. initial success: latency median dropped from 1.2s -> 310ms for these requests.
Jamie (SRE): still seeing ~60 queued requests for non-critical customers; autoscaler backoff cleared after quota note but new nodes not yet fully provisioned. ETA on cloud approval ~45-90m.
Robin (sales): sending ACME comms now, include mitigation steps and ETA.
Taylor (support): sharing final logs for thread: `placement_failed` traces, queued counts, and the curl repro. attaching to ticket #INC-5172.
Chris (eng): :thumbsup: good containment. we'll keep the manual re-route until cloud capacity confirmed.
Eva (ops): closing loop for now, tagging for postmortem ownership. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
